compiled_state.title: RED: integration test — full roundtrip with 16-hex IDs, alias, and concurrent transitions
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: RED

Write failing end-to-end integration test covering identity hardening and concurrency hardening together. Test must be RED until all component tasks are complete.

Acceptance criteria (a single integration test script):
- Step 1: create ticket; verify stdout last line matches 16-hex regex; verify CREATE event has data.alias field
- Step 2: resolve ticket by alias; verify returned ID matches canonical from step 1
- Step 3: transition to in_progress; verify STATUS event has parent_status_uuid=null (first in chain)
- Step 4: simulate concurrent transition (write a second STATUS event with same parent_status_uuid as step 3 event); replay reducer; verify fork detected, tie-break applied, final state is consistent (not 'conflicts')
- Step 5: verify PARENT_CHAIN_FORK_RESOLVED appears in reducer stderr output from step 4

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-hardening-integration.sh (new file — executable bit required)
Story DD coverage: SC1, SC2, SC3, SC4, SC6, SC7
Retry budget: 2 attempts
